swaptrade_tee_dialog_desc_about_autosell:
How orders are created

• After the associated market order is filled, auto-sell orders will be created based on your take-profit and stop-loss settings.
• Auto-sell order fees are calculated separately from the market order.
• Take-profit and stop-loss orders cannot be created if a valid token price is temporarily unavailable.

How take-profit and stop-loss orders are executed
• Take-profit and stop-loss prices are trigger prices, not guaranteed execution prices. Once triggered, orders are executed based on current market conditions, and the actual execution price may be higher or lower than the trigger price.
• Take-profit orders use your sell-side presets, including slippage, network fee, and anti-mev settings.
• Stop-loss orders use your sell-side presets but are not limited by your slippage setting. To improve the likelihood of execution during extreme market conditions, the actual execution price may be significantly lower than the trigger price.
• Tokens with high price volatility may experience rapid price drops or insufficient liquidity. Stop-loss orders are not guaranteed to execute at your preset loss percentage or to execute at all.

Other notes
• Disabling anti-mev may result in additional network fees.
• Open auto-sell orders will be paused when Trader Mode expires.
